Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
How would you like to work in IT, toying with cutting edge technologies and enjoying your life? At Orange Services, it’s possible!
 As one of the largest IT Hub within Orange Group, we are working internationally for both Orange corporate functions and country operations. Through a unique combination of know-how and expertise, our teams provide a broad range of IT & Business Solutions.
 Come closer to #LifeAtOrange! 
 What we’re looking for 
 We are seeking a hands-on and reliable development engineer, focused on evolving IaaS & CaaS systems, and the tools to operate them.
 What you’ll be doing
 We build cloud systems (IaaS and CaaS) and the tools to operate them at scale. If you are passionate about Ansible, Kubernetes, Openstack, the Python or Golang programming languages, we think we can provide you the best environment to take your engineering career to the next level.
 🚀 Your Mission 
 Innovate Core Services
Architect, code & unit-test new OpenStack & Kubernetes modules.
Craft elegant Python & Go SDKs and libraries for our platform.
Own Project Sylva features end-to-end, from spec to merge.
 Level-3 Power-Up
Dive into escalations, debug complex cases and ship rock-solid patches.
Harden and optimize community-driven code before it hits production.
 DevTool Wizardry
Build slick CLI tools, Flux CD plugins and Helm helpers.
Embed quality: author tests, linters, pre-commit hooks in CI.
 Open-Source Ambassadorship
Champion upstream contributions to CNCF, OpenStack & kube-ecosystem.
Keep our forks in sync, backport hot-fixes and upstream game-changers.
 What you need to know/have 
 Code: Go & Python mastery
 Cloud: Deep dive into OpenStack SDKs & K8s controllers
 Tooling: Helm, Flux CD plugin development, GitLab CI pipelines
 Collaboration: Agile sprints, code reviews & crisp documentation
 🎁 Extra Kudos 
You've shipped features or fixes to CNCF/OpenStack repositories.
You've built custom K8s operators or CRDs.
You live by "test first" with pytest, Ginkgo, etc.
 Depending on your experience level, what you will bring to the team 
 Junior
0-2 years building cloud-native code in Python/Go
Strong Linux knowledge and willingness to learn
 Mid
2-5 years crafting APIs or K8s operators
Owns services end-to-end and drives quality in every PR
 Senior
5+ years designing large-scale cloud platforms
Go/Python expert and Kubernetes API specialist
Mentoring and technical leadership experience
 What’s in it for you 
Performance Bonuses – based on your results & the company’s
Electronic Meal Tickets
Medical & Life insurance for you – facilities for your family, too
#WFH & Flexible hours
Professional GSM subscription
Personal GSM subscription, also (because we believe in communication!)
Special grants on Smartphones & devices; discounts for Orange products & services
Development Platforms:
Orange Learning
Trainings
Career Counselling
Coaching
Career plan mentoring
Wellbeing Programs – we support your Zen
 Orange Services is about bringing together people and technology
 Come & work for a #TopEmployer company. You could be part of an organization where great colleagues and team spirit support your professional development.
 At Orange, you can. 
 Diversity & Inclusion
 We encourage all candidate profiles, regardless of gender, age, race, citizenship, ethnicity, color, language, religion, social origin, genetic traits, sexual orientation, permanent or temporary disability, nationality, political choice, social category or social origins, situation or family responsibility, belonging to a disadvantaged category, membership or trade union activity.
 IMPORTANT
 In order to be able to follow your application status and receive relevant notifications, make sure to complete your application in our ATS (applicant tracking system), by following the redirection link.
 Once this step is completed, you will receive a confirmation email from Orange that your application has been successfully registered.
